### P13 Arraygen · Expression

```
// A gaussian bump running along the strip.
var tsec := t / 705600000;
var u := i / max(1, n - 1);
var head := frac(0.3 tsec);
var d := u - head;
exp(-0.5 (d / 0.08) ^ 2)
```

### P17 "Lissajoux" (Arraygen) · Expression

```
var tsec := t / 705600000;
var u := 2 pi i / n;
return [sin(3 u + 0.3 tsec), sin(4 u)]
```
